disposition.priority: Proceed to source- and time-grounded Memory x RS joint development after separate explicit authorization, rather than expand this stand-alone skill contest.

procedural_skill_improvement_proposals.constraints: Do not replace original twelve tasks, original twenty-four tasks, six skills, evaluation rules, or prior evidence. No new run package or model call here; any future comparison remains one bounded procedural candidate and must retain negative results.
procedural_skill_improvement_proposals.reason: Observed permission/metaconversation deferral and partial verification coverage; the original Method already mentions current permission, so reliable generator execution is not guaranteed by another wording change.
procedural_skill_improvement_proposals.scope: At most one explicit execution step linking current request/permission and known missing facts to a concrete allowed operation, preserving the existing applicability/stop checks. If help is already requested, perform one warranted verification/clarification move instead of asking permission again or shifting to generic feelings. Apply prior failed approaches only from legal Memory/current evidence.

evaluation_boundary.finding: The one R0 length result remains technical unknown; no resource improvement is awarded against it. Development observations are assistant-generated and do not qualify their own evaluator.

generator_execution.finding: Some replies replace a requested concrete verification step with renewed permission, broad affect discussion, or a request to restate missing information. R0 and Generic supply a useful verification route on the same task, so this deficit cannot all be assigned to retrieval.

representation.finding: Source-original narrative versus nonclinical adaptation and different token quantities cannot isolate a compression effect.

retrieval_supply.finding: The three entry/stop supplies produce two all-item passes and one uncertainty under RET; no substantiated failure is attributed solely to a different selected method. DP and RET share one unresolved deficit on another task despite different resources.

source_coverage.finding: All seven direct-core DP-Method replies meet the frozen items; five direct-partial tasks include one failure and one semantic uncertainty. These constraints often remain within baseline competence; broad professional capability is not established.

limitations: No independent human professional review is claimed.
Baseline ceiling and explicit constructed constraints limit the present standalone method study.
Paired DP/RET agreement on four tasks comes from exact physical reuse.
Original direct versus RET applicability labels are preserved even for the one identical planning supply whose labels differ.
primary_finding: No resolved positive DP-Method increment over R0 or Generic on the original twelve tasks: nine ties, two uncertainty overlaps, one resolved development deficit against each.
